senses.gloss: ने॑द् See s.v.
1. ने॑द् ind. (fr. न॑ + इद्), not, not indeed (= नैव, Sāy.), RV. viii, 5, 39; AV. &c.
in order that not, lest (with Subj. Pot. or Impv.; the verb accented, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 30), RV.; AV.; VS.; Br.
नेद् [cf. Zd. noid, ‘not’.]

2. नेद् cl. 1. P. नेदति, to go, flow (cf. अति-नेद् and Naigh. ii, 14), to censure, blame, Dhātup. xxi, 8 (cf. √ 1. निद् and निन्द्);
to be near, ib. (prob. an artificial meaning to explain नेदिष्ठ &c.)
नेद्य See अ॑-नेद्य.
नेदय (fr. नेद, see next) Nom. P. ˚यति, to bring near, Bhaṭṭ.

ने॑दिष्ठ mf(आ)n. (superl. of नेद substituted for अन्तिक, Pāṇ. v, 3, 63) the nearest, next, very near, RV. &c. &c. (अम् ind. next, in the first place, ib.; ˚ष्ठात् ind. from the neighbourhood, AitBr.; Kāṭh.)
= निपुण, L.
ने॑दिष्ठ m. Alangium Hexapetalum, L.
N. of a son of Manu Vaivasvata, VP.
ने॑दिष्ठम् ind., next, in the first place
ने॑दिष्ठात् ind., from the neighbourhood, AitBr.; Kāṭh.
ने॑दिष्ठ—तम (ने॑द्˚), mfn. the nearest of all, RV.
ने॑दिष्ठ—तमाम् (आम्), ind. ŚBr.
नेदिष्ठिन् mfn. very near, very nearly related, TāṇḍBr.; ŚrS.
ने॑दीयस् mfn. (compar. of नेद; cf. नेदिष्ठ and Pāṇ. v, 3, 63) nearer, very near, RV.; AitBr.
ने॑दीयस् (अस्), ind. near, hither, RV.; AV.; Br.
नेदी˚यस्-ता f. nearness, neighbourhood, ŚāṅkhBr.
नेदी˚यो-मरण mfn. whose death is near or imminent, Rājat. iv, 31.
